context.transcript:
This is Mr. Yu from Castor Bank.
I received a message that your news program wants to do a report about the 75th anniversary of our bank.
Yes, thanks for returning my call.
We're excited to feature Castor Bank because you're the oldest bank in the region.
Our viewers will be interested in your bank's history.
Then you should interview the bank president.
She's been with the bank for many years and is very knowledgeable.
Great.
Could I bring a cameraman so we can get some footage of the bank for the segment?
Sure, but you'll need a special press pass for taking video.
I'll contact the security department and have one ready for you.
context.transcript_translation:
我是来自 Castor Bank 的 Yu 先生。
我收到消息说您的新闻节目想做一份关于我们银行成立 75 周年纪念的报道。
是的，谢谢您回电给我。
我们很高兴能介绍 Castor Bank，因为它是该地区最古老的银行。
我们的观众会对贵行的历史感兴趣。
那么您应该采访一下银行总裁。
她已经在银行工作了很多年了，知识非常渊博。
太好了。
我可以带一名摄影师来吗？这样我们可以为节目拍摄一些银行的素材。
当然可以，但您需要一个特殊的媒体通行证才能进行视频拍摄。
我会联系安保部门，让您准备好一份。
